Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, EVENT_END_DT_TM, EVENT, RESULT_VALUE, RESULT_UNITS, NORMAL_LOW, NORMAL_HIGH, md5(to_json(row(WAREHOUSE_IDENTIFIER, EVENT_END_DT_TM, EVENT, RESULT_VALUE, RESULT_UNITS, NORMAL_LOW, NORMAL_HIGH))) as record_connection_identifier from ##duckdb_source## where trim(EVENT) = 'Glasgow Coma Score' and isfinite(try_cast(trim(RESULT_VALUE) as double)) and (RESULT_UNITS is null or lower(trim(RESULT_UNITS)) in ('', '<no data>')) order by all

Explanation.Description: Stable hash of the warehouse identifier and original event timestamp, name, result, units and ranges, preserving distinct readings across batches and identifying identical rows on reruns.
Glasgow Coma Score total only; GCS component responses and TAT risk scores are not selected.
Original numeric score; values are not clipped to the usual 3-15 range.
Dimensionless score; unexpected explicit physical units are excluded.
